answer: Stop sybils with a velvet rope, a violet watermark, and a nadir floor. Every newcomer starts at the nadir: zero influence, no shortcuts. To pass the velvet rope it must compute a verifiable delay function over the epoch beacon salted by its own address, sequential work no machine can shortcut, and carry a violet watermark: a sponsor's bond stamped on its application. The k-th newcomer one sponsor backs costs k squared in violet bond, so N clones pay roughly N cubed while sharing one rope. If any sponsored identity cheats, the sponsor's whole violet stake burns at once.
